name: Propylene glycol diacetate
description: Propylene glycol diacetate (CAS 623-84-7 ), commonly abbreviated as PGDA, is a diester solvent used across food, flavoring, and cosmetic applications. It is recognized under FEMA 4464 and functions as a carrier for flavor concentrates. This chemical serves as a solvent for fragrance compounds and active ingredients where clean solubility and low odor interference are required. In flavor manufacturing, it dissolves and dilutes concentrated flavor compounds for use in beverages. It is frequently utilized in confectionery and savory products, offering good miscibility with both polar and non-polar flavor components. Fragrance formulators use it as a carrier solvent in fine fragrances and functional products. The material acts as a low-odor, stable diluent that does not compete with the target scent profile. In personal care, it supports the incorporation of fragrance and active ingredients into lotions, creams, and leave-on formulations. Its FEMA-approved status also positions it for direct use as a flavoring agent in food products requiring mild acetate character. Propylene glycol diacetate is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid for industrial use. It is available in food-grade quality consistent with the FEMA designation, suitable for flavoring and fragrance applications. Bulk supply is standard in drums and IBC containers for large-scale manufacturing needs. Cosmetic-grade material is also available for personal care manufacturing, ensuring high purity and performance.
